name: cc-strategic-compaction
description: Compacts the conversation when the rules say the moment is right, judged against the conversation itself at the end of a turn.

judgeEnabled.title: Judge
judgeEnabled.description: Ask the judge at the end of each turn whether the moment is right. Off leaves the agent's own tool as the only way in.

toolEnabled.title: MCP Tool
toolEnabled.description: Register the MCP tool the agent calls to compact itself. Off leaves the judge as the only way in. Unregistering takes effect at the next session; until then a call is refused.

compactWhen.title: Your rules
compactWhen.description: When to compact, in your own words. Judged against the conversation at the end of each turn.

rulesMode.title: Your rules, how
rulesMode.description: append: your rules are added to the packaged ones. override: only yours are used.

askFromPercent.title: Judge from
askFromPercent.description: Percent of the context window below which nothing is judged, so early turns cost no model call. 0 judges every turn.

toolThreshold.title: After N calls
toolThreshold.description: Tool calls that compact on their own, counting every tool the main loop runs. Unrelated to the MCP Tool switch. 0 is off, which is the default: a count of calls says nothing about whether the moment is right.

toolInterval.title: Then every N calls
toolInterval.description: Further calls between tool-triggered compactions. Only read when the tool trigger is on.
